svg.title: Harvest contamination and hold boundary
svg.desc: A workflow separating clean harvest flow from suspect, dirty, mixed or unlabeled material, with isolation or hold, preserved identity, documentation and escalation instead of blending or independent release.
svg.text: Harvest contamination control: suspect material stays out of normal flow

g.text: Mold-like/suspect material • dirty cart/rack • mixed material • missing label
Identity conflict • contamination concern • active hold
1. Stop the affected movement and keep identity attached.
2. Isolate / hold / remove dirty equipment according to the supplied process.
3. Record the plant, lot, container, location, condition and action.
4. Escalate for qualified review. Do not blend, conceal, relabel, or independently release.
Hold status is part of the traceability chain; held or diverted quantity does not disappear from the history.
